Qualifications:

• 7+ years of mainframe development experience, preferably within a financial services environment

• Strong proficiency in COBOL, JCL, DB2, VSAM, and CICS

• Hands-on experience with Control-M, MQ Series, and Easytrieve or REXX

• Strong understanding of batch processing, online transaction processing, file-based data flows, and EBCDIC data handling

• Experience with production support and incident resolution

• Experience with CI/CD practices and source control tools such as Endevor, GitLab, or similar SCM platforms

• Experience working within large-scale enterprise environments

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills

• Bachelor's degree required
